findings.claim: Deferring `utils.getMessage` into the failure branch changes observable behavior for passing assertions whose arguments are expensive or hostile to serialize (throwing getters, very large or circular structures): previously the formatting cost/throw happened on every call, now only on failure.
findings.rationale: This is almost certainly the intent of the change (a perf win, and arguably a fix since a passing assertion should not throw while building a message it never uses). Flagging only because it is an observable change for anything relying on the eager objDisplay path. Chai's getMessage/getActual are read-only with respect to assertion flags, and the array indices ([pass, posMsg, negMsg, args]) are preserved, so the message text itself is unchanged. Low confidence this matters in practice.
